critique: Nothing lands on the grid: the hero settles at 4.4–4.45s (ring Expo Out, dot Back Out) instead of on the 4.0s drop, and every build pulse and secondary hit peaks 0.08–0.12s after its beat (0.62, 1.12, 5.6, 6.12…). The sync reads as late throughout. The broken ring trim-on also leaves the build as just a fade, and the wordmark drifts in with a soft 0.8s Easy Ease well after the drop.

Re-time the peaks to the 0.5s grid: put the ring/dot impact and the wordmark's arrival frame exactly at 4.0s, with the anticipation squash ending at 3.97s, and land each build pulse and secondary hit on its beat with a fast attack and a Quad Out decay after it. Then replace the non-rendering trim with a working draw-on so the build accelerates into the drop.
